commands.description: Will apply a troll mode (See 'Feed The Trolls') to a player, shows a menu of options. Both player and category are optional. Will jump to category and player respectively.
Will reset all troll modes on a player
Will list all users & the modes that are applied on them. If a player is provided, more details are shown such the names of the enabled flag(s)
Shows all the feedthetrolls commands incase you forget in game.
Activates manual auto punishment on the last person to start a crescendo
Marks the player to be banned when they leave, and prevents any friendly fire. Run again to unmark.
Not as subtle as swarming a player, will just blind them like they got boomed on, and attract commons to them obviously
Sets the player’s permanent health to this amount. < 0 will give them insane amount of health, 100 can give them extra as temporary health is added on.
Kills the given player(s)
Staggers the given player(s)
Make the player get shoved like a charger charged them
Slaps the player around, optionally dealing damage
Respawns the player at wherever you are looking.
commands.note: Will respawn (& reset) alive players!!! Will reset their inventory and health

commands.description: Sets your model or an optional player's model to the survivor specified.
examples: %cmd% grace rochelle - Sets the player's model that has the name 'grace' to rochelle

commands.description: Add a note to a player
View notes for a player
Quicky applies the inputted reverse friendly fire amountt
Send an apology to a player, reason being inserted "Sorry I (reason here) shot you (player name)
Opens a menu, letting you select the player to apology to
Spawns a car on a player from the given direction. If no direction provided, will show a menu
Bans the player(s) for the optional specified time. A time of 0 makes the ban permament.
Kicks the player(s) for the specified optional reason.
commands.note: On 5+ servers, it may cause their bot to reset with full health and no items

commands.description: Will open a menu with a list of disconnected players. Select a player to activate a ban on them. Just permanently ban them if they are for sure troll and not a noob.
Will make the player immune to being banned for friendly fire or auto reverse ff. (Only lasts one session, will clear any pending bans)
Mutes them from voice chat, resets on map change. Use 'Voice Mute' troll for persistance
Mutes them from text chat
Will mute all vocalizations from this player only for you. For global gags use troll mode vocalize gag
Sets the server's permission level. It will kick players with "Server is Reserved" when they join if in admins-only or private. Notify will only notify all players when a player is connecting.
Kicks a player with a predefined message of "Sorry, this server is reserved" and indicates to others you kicked them to free a slot.
Shows information about friendly fire, auto rff, immunity status, and more of a player.
Renames the specified player, resets the next chapter
Will force the director to spawn X whatever special normally, bypassing normal limits
examples: %cmd% smoker 5 - Spawns 5 smokers in the area

commands.description: Will spawn specified special near the specified player, with target only on them. Defaults to jockey if no special specified.
examples: %cmd% insta pea jockey - Spawns a jockey near pea

commands.description: Will spawn specified special as close as possible to them. Basically on top
examples: %cmd% insta pea jockey - Spawns a jockey on pea

commands.description: Will force the director to spawn X at your cursor at set amount
Shows GUI of specials to spawn bypassing director limits
Shows GUI of specials to spawn at your cursor
Makes all witches attack the victim
Opens an admin menu with some menus such as voting, player interactions, weapon spawning, etc
Will make all dead players respawn at the next available respawn closet. It won’t work for already opened rooms, even if door is closed.
Will force the director to spawn X whatever special normally, bypassing normal limits
Forces a panic event, can be used in addition to swarm or vomitplayer commands.
Will spawn any amount of a specified weapon wherever your mouse is pointing at.  Weapon names must be exact, unlike give.
examples: Discover item ids by googling l4d2 item ids, or by typing give in console, then whatever autocompletes put into sm_give (give != sm_give)

commands.description: Same as above, except will directly put them in your hand, or drops on ground if you have no free hand
examples: Discover item ids by googling l4d2 item ids, or by typing give in console, then whatever autocompletes put into sm_give (give != sm_give)

commands.description: Will show the population of all uncommon special types (ex. clowns)
Will print out (very hard to understand text) information about every player, their full ping, user id, etc. Only can be used in console
Sets up honks (sets population to 40%, sets the max shove timeout up)
Plays the specified soundpath to specified player(s). Automatically stops last sound
Stops the soundpath for the selected player(s). If blank will stop last played sound
Swaps the two players' locations. If second player not filled in, it will be yourself.
Removes the lobby reservation, which allows extra players to join (on improved+)
Opens a menu to select clientside options, such as disallowing being a player hat
Will hat whatever entity / player you are looking at, or if hatted / hatting, return them to where you picked them up
Will yeet the hat forwards, if hat was a player, they will get a few seconds of invincibility
Instead of returning to where picked up, this will place the hat right infront of you.
Places the hat where your cursor is, this does not rotate the entity which can help in moving items
Selects the location where the hat is mounted on you.
Starts editing entity you are looking at
Cancels entity edit or wall creation
Completes the wall creation or entity edit (can also use %prefix%edit build)
Duplicates the entity you are currently editing, and starts editing the copy
